title: Swiipt Product Page Content
description: The authored bits for the WooCommerce single-product page: hero copy (three-layer title architecture), short description, and the situation block. The rest of the product page (before/after, what's included, journey, check-in plan, TSM, failure points, evidence note) is assembled FROM the records at render time by the theme (inc/product-details.php), so it cannot drift. The publisher writes these authored bits into the Woo product; the landing page's CTA links here, and add-to-cart/checkout happen on this page.

source.description: factory-generator = produced by harness/gen-content.mjs. manual-port = hand-structured reference; never overwritten by the generator.

short_description.description: Woo product short description; the publisher writes this into the product.

body.description: The buyer's situation in her own words, from transformation.situation.specific_situation.
